name: Yondenko Corporation
summary: Yondenko Corporation engages in the electrical, and electrical power transmission and distribution facilities, construction activities in Japan. It operates through three segments: Equipment Construction Business, Leasing Business, and Solar Power Generation Business. The Equipment Construction Business segment undertakes and executes power distribution construction, power transmission and civil engineering construction, electrical and instrumentation construction, air conditioning and piping construction, and information and communication construction.
